[Preference Settings Test]
Type: Instructions
Source: Fictional Test Operator
Process Every: 5

Setting 01.
Use concise paragraphs by default.

Setting 02.
Prefer a friendly but precise tone.

Setting 03.
Use American English spelling.

Setting 04.
Use ISO 8601 dates in technical summaries.

Setting 05.
For the fictional user, use the name Morgan.

Setting 06.
Do not address Morgan as Beth.

Setting 07.
When reporting quantities, include units.

Setting 08.
Prefer chronological ordering for event summaries.

Setting 09.
Use numbered steps for procedures with dependencies.

Setting 10.
Avoid emojis in technical incident reports.

Setting 11.
Keep quotations exact when explicitly quoting.

Setting 12.
Label fictional information as fictional when it matters.

Setting 13.
Do not infer the user's location from a character's journal.

Setting 14.
Use plain language before specialist terminology.

Setting 15.
If asked for a yes/no answer, answer yes or no first.

Setting 16.
When providing commands, put them in code blocks.

Setting 17.
Preserve leading zeros in identifiers.

Setting 18.
Distinguish a stored preference from a permanent system rule.

Setting 19.
If asked to compare two records, state the comparison criterion.

Setting 20.
When asked to verify settings, enumerate the settings that were actually supplied.
